title: Aged Care Amendment (Registered Nurses Ensuring Quality Care) Bill 2021
short_title: Aged Care Amendment (Registered Nurses Ensuring Quality Care) Bill 2021

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require every licensed nursing home in Australia to have a registered nurse working at all times.
It amends the Aged Care Act 1997 to add a new responsibility for approved providers to ensure a registered nurse is always on duty in facilities offering residential or flexible care.
The change would take effect the day after the bill receives royal assent.
changes: Requires all approved aged care facilities to have a registered nurse on duty at all times.
Adds a new paragraph to the Aged Care Act defining this as a provider responsibility.
Defines 'registered nurse' by reference to state or territory registration laws.
summary.affected: Approved aged care facilities, their residents, and registered nurses.
